execution: Three sequential fresh Node processes. Same original timed loops, query lattice, warmups, alternating order, calibration and source/kernel files. Only module bundling adapter and repository-root resolution differ from the frozen runner.
analysis: Report every repetition and every case, ratio of family latency medians per repetition, full min/max range across the three repetitions. Do not select fastest runs, pool correlated rows as independent replications or label the observed range a confidence interval.
failure: Keep every completed and failed run; stop after a process failure. Do not silently rerun failed or unfavourable measurements. A new attempt requires a fresh directory and separate report.
scope: Same-device native CPU query repetitions on five exact analytic function fixtures. Not ArcGIS software, paper-author timing, browser/GPU rendering, surveyed terrain accuracy or cross-device performance. Do not run this producer concurrently with other task-owned builds or numeric audits. Background OS load remains uncontrolled.
